summary: Sprint 4 declared done-gates tier 1 is complete. Non-draft tier 1 children are closed with passed verification evidence: schema support, closeout enforcement, and CLI/directive surfacing. The tier 2 execute-at-close item is closed as a proposal-only design note at docs/decisions/tier-2-execute-at-close-gates.md, with implementation still gated on future owner sign-off. The declared gate path now records declaredCommand and expectedObservable, rejects mismatched closeout evidence, and surfaces declared gates to executors through CLI/directives.
